items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Ike Quebec had joined us later and augmented the group.

ctx.x: So we strolled for two nights, and we had one more night before the week was ended. We'd have a day off. The -- not the week wasn't ended, but that was the day our day off would fall on. So the owner, manager, proprietor, Al Barnes, he gave Charlie the day off to go into Chicago and get another piano player. So he gave us a bottle of Seagram's V.O. to take on the train with us, because he had been gracious enough to keep us furnished at the club. He wanted us to have a good trip, you know? So, while Charlie was…
